title: Recording the Charge Kept Back on a Car Rental Given Up
content:
Where a renter gives up a confirmed rental booked on the Car Rental Rate Classes, a charge is kept back on
that rental. It is withheld from the money the renter has already settled in advance rather than billed to
them separately, and once recorded it stands on the rental as a charge the renter can see.

## The handling action

The renter's own confirmation of the charge is recorded against the rental. The tool
`confirm_cancellation_charge_358c6472` is unlocked and handed over to be run by the customer themselves;
the desk does not run it on their behalf. One call books a single charge line on that rental for the amount
confirmed, marks it as arising from the renter giving the rental up, and points it at the advance payment
the money is held back from, so the rental's net charged total rises by the amount confirmed.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drive_rental_id` | the internal reference number of the car rental the charge is booked against | an identifier, read from the rental record returned by the car rental lookup |
| `customer_id` | the traveller reference number of the renter the charge belongs to | an identifier, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup |
| `source_entry_id` | the reference number of the advance payment line on that rental that the charge is kept back from | an identifier, read from the rental ledger lookup |
| `cancellation_charge_usd` | the amount kept back | a US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent at the moment it is booked, given as a positive figure and never left empty |

None of the four parameters carries a fixed set of permitted values; each is the value the record or the
figure gives.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number of the new charge line, the rental it was booked
against and the amount kept back in US dollars to 2 decimal places. A sentence of that shape means the line
is on the rental's ledger; any other reply means nothing was booked.
